host: AWS EC2 m7i.xlarge (4 vCPU, 16 GiB, us-east-2), nothing else running
note: The Docker task runner and the Process task runner do not use the same interpreter. Both are recorded below. fibo33_s is three consecutive timings of fibo(33) measured inside the container or process that actually runs the task; fibo10_s is the mean of 1000 fibo(10) calls in the same place.

python_docker.configuration: default Docker task runner (io.kestra.plugin.scripts.runner.docker.Docker), containerImage: python:slim
python_docker.measured_in: a python:slim container, the image the Docker task runner starts per task

python_process.command_kestra_runs: /bin/sh -c 'python3.12 <script>.py'  (preceded per task by: uv --version; uv python find --system --no-managed-python; /usr/bin/python --version)

js_docker.configuration: default Docker task runner, plugin default containerImage: node
js_docker.measured_in: a node container (docker.io/library/node:latest), the image the Docker task runner starts per task

js_process.measured_in: the Kestra worker; Node.js v26.11.1 installed from the official linux-x64 tarball because the kestra image ships no node

docker_task_runner_overhead.note: Per-task container lifecycle the Docker task runner pays, measured on the host, mean of 20 runs.
